# Security & Comprehensive Requirements Review Checklist: Fix JWT Issuer Validation

**Purpose**: Strict security gate and comprehensive review validating requirements quality, completeness, and edge case coverage for multi-environment JWT issuer validation.
**Created**: 2026-09-14
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 - Are the allowed issuer URIs explicitly enumerated for both external host and internal container network paths? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001]
- [x] CHK002 - Are requirements defined for all five secured domain microservices in the platform? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005]
- [x] CHK003 - Is the relationship between Swagger UI Bearer authorization and backend token validation explicitly specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003]
- [x] CHK004 - Are configuration properties and fallback defaults documented for environments where internal networking is not used? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002]

## Requirement Clarity & Precision

- [x] CHK005 - Is the exact HTTP error code (401 vs 403) unambiguously distinguished between token-level rejections and role authorization failures? [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK006 - Are standard RFC 6750 error attribute requirements (error="invalid_token", error_description) specified for authentication challenge responses? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006]
- [x] CHK007 - Is the distinction between token expiration timestamp checks and issuer claim validation explicitly defined? [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK008 - Do issuer validation requirements align across direct cURL, Swagger UI, and inter-service invocation paths? [Consistency, Spec §US1, §US2]
- [x] CHK009 - Are security requirements consistent between the default local profile and the containerized docker profile? [Consistency, Spec §FR-002]
- [x] CHK010 - Do the success criteria align with the measurable outcomes across all three seeded user roles (customer, manager, admin)? [Consistency, Spec §SC-003]

## Security & Threat Mitigation (Strict Gate)

- [x] CHK011 - Does the spec strictly mandate that cryptographic signature verification against Keycloak JWKS keys cannot be bypassed or weakened? [Security, Spec §FR-004]
- [x] CHK012 - Are requirements defined to reject tokens issued by unapproved realms or untrusted external identity providers? [Security, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK013 - Are token rejection error messages required to prevent internal system or stack trace leakage to unauthenticated callers? [Security, Spec §FR-006]
- [x] CHK014 - Does the specification enforce that only explicitly listed or whitelisted issuers are accepted rather than accepting arbitrary wildcard domains? [Security, Spec §FR-001]

## Scenario & Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK015 - Are requirements specified for handling malformed tokens missing the iss claim entirely? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK016 - Are requirements defined for handling expired tokens that otherwise possess a valid issuer claim? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK017 - Are requirements specified for unauthenticated requests with missing Authorization headers? [Coverage, Spec §US1.3]
- [x] CHK018 - Are requirements defined for handling Keycloak temporary unavailability or JWKS key endpoint network timeouts? [Coverage, Gap]

## Multi-Environment Configuration & Profiles

- [x] CHK019 - Are requirements specified for overriding accepted issuers via environment variables without recompilation? [Traceability, Spec §FR-002]
- [x] CHK020 - Are profile activation expectations documented for containerized deployment manifests (docker-compose.apps.yml)? [Traceability, Spec §US2]

## Acceptance Criteria Measurability

- [x] CHK021 - Can SC-001 (100% acceptance of valid non-expired tokens across all protected endpoints) be objectively and independently verified? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [x] CHK022 - Can SC-002 (first-attempt Swagger UI operation execution) be tested with concrete pass/fail criteria? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [x] CHK023 - Is zero security regression (SC-004) quantifiable via automated negative security test suites? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
